acceptanceCriteria: the gate timeoutSeconds bound is raised (target 14400 s) with a numbered Tasks requirement stating the bound and its relation to lease, heartbeat and detach limits
policy validation accepts the new maximum and refuses one above it (LIMIT_EXCEEDED), with tests; older-binary compatibility limit recorded
after a rebuilt corvint-tasks is installed, a store policy update (v12) sets full-gate timeoutSeconds to the new bound, carried to .taskman/policy.json by PR
body: Observed 2026-10-16 with corvint-tasks build 558, policy v11. V1-0252's full-gate (`make gate`, timeoutSeconds 7200) ended FAILED/TIMEOUT twice; the second run went 00:59:44Z-02:59:44Z at load averages ~64 (16 concurrent builder lanes), receipt in $S/agent-0252/gate-full-gate.out. The owner pre-approved raising the full-gate timeout (2026-10-15), but the store policy cannot express it: internal/tasks/intent/policy.go bounds gate timeoutSeconds by wire.MaxGateTimeoutSecs = 120*60 (internal/tasks/wire/limits.go:105). Expected: a gate timeout bound large enough for the full gate on a loaded host, kept inside the lease/heartbeat and detach bounds (attempt_run maxRunTimeoutSeconds = MaxLeaseMinutes*60-130). Actual: 7200 s hard cap; every full-gate ticket (V1-0252..0255, V1-0414, V1-0150, V1-0285) stalls while lanes run.
title: Tasks gate timeoutSeconds is capped at 7200 s by wire.MaxGateTimeoutSecs, so full-gate times out under multi-lane load
